Product.title: Product
Product.description: Lifecycle Organics ecological bio-fertilizers and crop defense formulas

brand.description: Product category banner or brand label

tagline.description: Key marketing catchphrase or agronomic promise

category.description: Agricultural category (e.g. Bio-Fertilizers, Crop Defense, Pest Control)

description.description: Detailed agronomic summary and formulation highlights

badge.description: High-impact visual badge (e.g. 10x Faster Growth, 4-in-1 Protection)

price.description: Standard retail unit price per 5L canister in Zambian Kwacha (ZMW)

image.description: Relative or public URL to high-resolution product photography

benefits.description: Bullet points highlighting field and crop advantages

specs.description: Technical parameters like volume, dilution, and targets

usage.description: Application rate, knapsack sprayer dilution, and timing instructions

inStock.description: Availability flag for distribution and online inquiries

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last specification update

Testimonial.title: Testimonial
Testimonial.description: Field results and reviews from commercial growers and cooperatives

author.description: Full name of the farmer or farm manager

role.description: Title or position of the reviewer

farmOrCompany.description: Name of the farm, estate, or agricultural cooperative

location.description: District or province in Zambia (e.g. Mkushi, Chisamba, Copperbelt)

crop.description: Primary crop cultivated (e.g. Maize, Tomatoes, Soya, Wheat)

quote.description: Verbatim field testimonial detailing yield and pest results

featured.description: Whether to highlight on public homepage

approved.description: Moderation status by the farm management team

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when submitted or recorded

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Customer purchase inquiry, quote request, or agronomic question

contact.description: Phone number, WhatsApp, or email address

quantity.description: Requested number of canisters or treated hectares

message.description: Specific crop questions, field conditions, or delivery details
